newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish PZU to pay PLN 568 mln in flood damages.
newsitem.headline: Polish PZU to pay PLN 568 mln in flood damages.

text.p: Poland's state-owned insurer PZU estimates it will have to pay about 568 million zlotys in damages caused by July's flood, PZU said on Thursday.

"According to our newest estimates, the number of claims on areas affected by the flood is 117,000 and PZU's estimated liabilities may increase to 568 million zlotys," the company said in a statement.
PZU has earlier estimates its flood damages at 320 million zlotys.
It said it had already paid nearly 30 million zlotys in damages.
In June 1997, PZU reported its net profit reaching 204.9 million zlotys after the first quarter of the year. Its losses amounted to 169.7 million zlotys in 1996.
